stories.title: New US tariffs on China, EU and others
stories.what: The US announced plans for a fresh round of tariffs on goods from China, the European Union and a dozen other economies, citing overcapacity, after the Supreme Court found earlier sweeping import taxes unconstitutional.
stories.why_it_matters: Tariff rounds redirect and distort container trade flows and can disrupt box shipping volumes and routings.
stories.latest: Tariffs announced today; trade press reports they could again disrupt and distort container shipping and trade.
sources: U.S. Targets China, EU With New Tariffs Citing Overcapacity
Tariffs return to haunt box shipping

stories.title: Attacks and escalation around Hormuz
stories.what: Attacks on commercial shipping in and around the Strait of Hormuz continue, following tanker incidents near Oman, a mine strike east of Hormuz and a projectile hit on an outbound tanker.
stories.why_it_matters: Hull strikes and mines raise war-risk premiums for Arabian Gulf liftings, slow transits and shrink the pool of willing owners, reshaping crude, product and gas ton-miles.
stories.latest: Gibson reported that tanker day rates for Hormuz transits remain above $1 million despite charter rates coming off historic highs.
sources: Gibson: Tanker Day Rates for Hormuz Transits Remain Above $1 Million

stories.title: Saudi-Houthi strikes hit energy and port infrastructure
stories.what: Riyadh, the Houthi-controlled port of Hodeidah and the Saudi terminal at Ras Tanura were hit in an exchange of fire earlier this week.
stories.why_it_matters: Strikes on a major crude loading terminal and a Red Sea port threaten liftings, raise war-risk premiums and can reroute crude and product tonnage away from the region.

stories.title: Drone strikes on Russian-linked shipping beyond the Black Sea
stories.what: The Russian RoRo Sparta II was struck by a suspected drone in the Baltic and drifted into Finnish waters, and Ukrainian drone boats attacked Russian warships at Benghazi in Libya.
stories.why_it_matters: Strikes in the Baltic and Mediterranean extend the war-risk zone for merchant shipping far beyond the Black Sea, affecting insurance cover, routing and port calls.

stories.title: Russian refining damage and diesel export limits
stories.what: Ukrainian drone attacks have cut Russian refineries' combined crude processing by 45% since late October, on top of a Russian ban on most diesel exports extended to end-January.
stories.why_it_matters: Lost Russian refining and export restrictions reshape clean product ton-miles, pulling diesel from longer-haul sources and changing MR and LR employment.

stories.title: IMO net-zero rules for LNG and alternative fuels
stories.what: The IMO's Marine Environment Protection Committee opens MEPC85 on 30 November without final rules on how LNG, bio-LNG and e-LNG carbon values are measured under the Net-Zero Framework.
stories.why_it_matters: The accounting treatment of LNG determines the compliance economics of LNG-fuelled tonnage and newbuilding decisions, including LNG carrier and dual-fuel orders now being placed.
stories.latest: No rules news today, but further alternative-fuel tonnage was reported: COSL ordered 46 LNG-powered PSVs in China, SeaRoad took delivery of an LNG-powered RoRo, and Hudong-Zhonghua set a Chinese record with 12 large LNG carriers delivered this year.
sources: COSL orders 46 LNG-powered PSVs in China
SeaRoad takes delivery of LNG-powered Ro-Ro
Hudong-Zhonghua hits new LNG carrier delivery record
